criteria.matches_direction: Removed two stands; continuous stepped cast bed now joins controller and cylinder, crankcase extends six units toward control face, whole working assembly lowered one unit. Native front/rear views match key structural reference landmarks.
criteria.geometry_uvs: 144 native cuboids; UVs within atlas at established density. Support posts removed. Bed joins at anchor boundary, no coincident exposed top caps.
criteria.material_consistency: Current quiet cast iron reused on continuous bed; access accents retained on covers only. No new random noise or decorative feet.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: Same 3x3 bed, eight casing slabs and component anchors. Controller front integrated into casting. Fuel front/lubricant underneath unchanged.
criteria.animation_states: Wheel, shaft and cylinder axis all lowered one unit to y24; pivot matches. Worst swept wheel clears slab bed by about 0.845 model units; narrow cast bed lies beside wheel, not under it.
criteria.native_size_readability: Viewed actual native front/rear model: continuous grounded silhouette and no empty shelf above controller. Shader review follows.
